name: Quest claim on command
description: posted + command=claim -> claimed. Sets claimed_by from the caller's quest.claim.requested_by arg triple, increments the attempt counter atomically with the claim (spec: attempt increment atomic with claim), and clears the command to a sentinel so it cannot re-fire when the quest re-enters posted on a fail-retry.

name: Quest start on command
description: claimed + command=start -> in_progress. Clears the command atomically. questbridge dispatches the agentic loop on the in_progress phase.
